verdict.rationale: CIPO is an IP office with online filing services, MyCIPO accounts and downloadable bulk data. An office like this could plausibly offer programmatic event callbacks, such as application status changes, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. Electronic correspondence and bulk data downloads are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
